epic.title: Pokédex, moves and type chart
epic.description: Screens B1–B5: the species list with version-aware filters, the Pokémon page, moves, move page and type chart.

features.title: Pokédex list
tasks: Species list API with paging and version markers
Version-aware filters (type, generation, stats, Mega / Shadow / Dynamax / G-Max, regional forms, legendary, released): match any version, show the best-matching one, hide non-matching badges
Search by name, number or nickname (English and Portuguese names)
Sort by any column
Phone list with filter sheet; desktop table with filter bar
Pokédex tab switcher: Pokémon · Moves · Type chart
Version marker hover (desktop) / tap (phone) switches the row to that version's stats

features.title: Pokémon page
tasks: Header tinted by main type; version switcher (normal, Shadow, Mega…)
Overview: stats, max CP, rankings summary, type matchups (link to type chart)
Moves: best movesets per raid type and league; full movepool with raid and PvP numbers, Elite TM / legacy / event flags
Moveset ranking: every fast + charged combination for raids and PvP
IVs: best IVs per league, keeper bars, search string with Copy; IV rank checker
100% CP cheat sheet
Get it: right now (from live data) and usual ways; evolution chain with costs and conditions
Versions: forms, costumes, shiny, Shadow, Mega with their stats
Phone tabs (Overview · Moves · IVs · Get it · Versions); desktop two columns

features.title: Moves list
tasks: Moves API with raid and PvP numbers and PvP effects
Fast / Charged switch, type filter, search and sort
Phone Raids / PvP number switch; desktop both side by side

features.title: Move page
tasks: Learners grouped Elite TM / Legacy / normal, sorted by Attack, with 'Mega too'
Event note when an event gives the move
Phone: top 8 + Show all; desktop grid

features.title: Type chart
tasks: Defending (one or two types), Attacking and the full 18×18 chart
Links to Pokémon with that typing and to moves of that type
